title: List memory stores
summary: List persistent memory stores available for sessions and resources. Archived stores are excluded unless include_archived=true is passed.

parameters.name: include_archived
parameters.description: Optional. Pass true to include archived stores, which are returned with status "archived" and a non-null archived_at. Omitting it, or passing false, excludes them. Any other value is a 400.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Human-readable store name.

parameters.name: description
parameters.description: Optional store description.

parameters.name: metadata
parameters.description: Opaque tags.

title: Update memory store
summary: Patch a memory store's name, description, and metadata. Omitted fields are preserved; description clears on null or empty string; a metadata key set to null or "" is deleted. An archived store is read-only and answers 409 memory_store_archived. PUT is a deprecated alias with identical semantics.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: New store name, 1-255 characters without control characters.

parameters.name: description
parameters.description: New description. null or an empty string clears it.

parameters.name: metadata
parameters.description: Metadata patch: a string value upserts the key, null or "" deletes it.

title: Update memory store (deprecated PUT alias)
summary: Deprecated alias of POST /v1/memory_stores/{memory_store_id} with identical patch semantics. Use POST.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: New store name, 1-255 characters without control characters.

parameters.name: description
parameters.description: New description. null or an empty string clears it.

parameters.name: metadata
parameters.description: Metadata patch: a string value upserts the key, null or "" deletes it.

title: Delete memory store
summary: Physically delete a memory store and cascade over its memory and version rows. Returns {id, type: "memory_store_deleted"}. Refuses with 409 memory_store_in_use while a non-terminal session mounts the store.

title: List memories
summary: List memories in a store. view=basic (default) returns each memory with content null while content_sha256 and content_size_bytes stay populated; view=full embeds content.

response.name: data
response.description: Published memory objects (id, memory_store_id, memory_version_id, path, content, content_sha256, content_size_bytes, timestamps).

parameters.name: path_prefix
parameters.description: Optional. Absolute path ending in /; matching is segment-based.

parameters.name: depth
parameters.description: Optional. 0 lists the whole subtree, 1 lists only direct children.

parameters.name: view
parameters.description: Optional. basic (default) or full.

title: Create memory
summary: Create a memory at a path inside the store. A path already held by another memory is a 409 memory_path_conflict_error. The response uses view=basic unless view=full is passed.

parameters.name: path
parameters.description: Absolute memory path, e.g. /notes/release.

parameters.name: content
parameters.description: UTF-8 content, max 100 kB.

parameters.name: view
parameters.description: Optional query param. basic (default) or full.

title: Get memory
summary: Retrieve a memory. view defaults to full so content is embedded unless view=basic is passed.

parameters.name: view
parameters.description: Optional query param. full (default) or basic.

title: Update memory
summary: Update a memory by id. POST is the published verb; PUT is a deprecated alias. A content_sha256 precondition mismatch is a 409 memory_precondition_failed_error carrying current_content_sha256, unless the stored state already equals the requested content and path.

parameters.name: path
parameters.description: New path.

parameters.name: content
parameters.description: New content.

parameters.name: precondition
parameters.description: Optional {type: content_sha256, content_sha256} optimistic-concurrency check.

parameters.name: view
parameters.description: Optional query param. basic (default) or full.

title: Update memory (deprecated PUT alias)
summary: Deprecated alias of POST /v1/memory_stores/{memory_store_id}/memories/{memory_id} with identical semantics. Use POST.

title: Delete memory
summary: Delete a memory. Optional expected_content_sha256 query param refuses a delete when the hash no longer matches, with 409 memory_precondition_failed_error. Returns {id, type: "memory_deleted"}.

parameters.name: expected_content_sha256
parameters.description: Optional query param. Delete only if the current hash matches.

title: Archive memory store
summary: Archive a memory store and hide it from active resource selection.

title: List memory versions
summary: List recorded versions of a store, newest first. operation filters by created|modified|deleted; view=basic (default) nulls content while content_sha256 and content_size_bytes stay populated.

parameters.name: memory_id
parameters.description: Optional. Restrict the listing to one memory.

parameters.name: operation
parameters.description: Optional. created, modified, or deleted.

parameters.name: view
parameters.description: Optional. basic (default) or full.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Optional page size (1-100, default 20).

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Optional cursor from a previous page.

response.name: data
response.description: Recorded versions. Each carries its version number, the content hash and byte size as written, the change kind, and the session that made it.

title: Get a memory version
summary: Retrieve one recorded version. view defaults to full; a redacted or deleted version answers null payload fields.

response.name: content_sha256
response.description: Digest of the content as it was written, so a version can be verified without trusting the row.

title: Redact memory version
summary: Clear a version payload: content, path, content_sha256, and content_size_bytes become null and redacted_at is set, while the row stays listable. The memory head version is refused with 409 memory_version_is_head.
